agyos_skill.intent: Multi-agent swarm intelligence and scenario prediction engine. Builds GraphRAG knowledge graphs from seed documents, provisions memory-backed synthetic agent populations, executes multi-round market and behavioral simulations, and compiles structured prediction reports.
agyos_skill.instructions: A structured operational framework for configuring, running, and analyzing multi-agent swarm simulations. It ingests seed documents, constructs an ontology and knowledge graph, initializes a population of synthetic agents with episodic memory, simulates multi-round behavioral interactions, and synthesizes empirical outcome reports. The simulation architecture operates across four distinct subsystems: 1. Interaction Frontend: Web interface (default port 3000) for uploading seed material, defining prediction hypotheses, tracking real-time agent dialogues, and reviewing compiled reports. 2. Simulation Backend: API server (default port 5001) managing document parsing, ontology generation, simulation state loops, and entity memory stores. 3. Language Model Inference: OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint powering agent decision-making, dialogue generation, and final report synthesis. 4. Entity Memory & Knowledge Graph: GraphRAG knowledge store anchoring agent personas to verified ground truths extracted from uploaded source material. Define the required parameters in `.env` before initiating simulations: ```bash LLM_API_KEY="your-llm-api-key" LLM_BASE_URL="https://api.deepseek.com/v1" LLM_MODEL_NAME="deepseek-chat" LLM_BOOST_API_KEY="" LLM_BOOST_BASE_URL="" LLM_BOOST_MODEL_NAME="" ZEP_API_KEY="your-zep-api-key" OASIS_DEFAULT_MAX_ROUNDS=10 VITE_API_BASE_URL="http://localhost:5001" ``` Security note: Never commit `.env` containing live API credentials to version control. Prerequisites: Node.js 18+, Python 3.11-3.12, `uv` package manager. ```bash npm run setup:all npm run dev ``` ```yaml
